snippet.title: Patience Balls - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Patience Balls is a simplistic puzzle game where you use the precision of your hands to complete many puzzles while challenging your brain.
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rikzu.patience.balls
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id1630926274

The goal is straightforward. Place the balls in all the holes of the puzzles. Can you complete them all?

Patience Balls is a game with:
- Many types of puzzles including mazes and labyrinths to test your patience
- Beautiful simplistic graphics that run on any device
- Achievements and leaderboards

Website: https://www.rikzugames.com/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/rikzugames/
Discord: https://discord.gg/jBawCAe
